operative_context: Multi-currency conversion must maintain integrity between stored financial records and customer-facing display totals
exceptions: Pilot-specific currency presentation may require clarification on whether it is a temporary behavior or permanent operational rule
conflicts_or_obsolete: Display-friendly simplification in one layer that produces visible mismatches with stored totals should not be implemented
Cleaner presentation format in pilot currency scenarios that diverges from persisted billing amounts is not acceptable
notes: R71 targets multi-currency conversion integrity. PRIMARY evidence (E1-E6) establishes that currency conversion must maintain strict alignment between stored records and customer-facing outputs, and that presentation simplifications must not create financial discrepancies. CONTEXT evidence (E7-E8) reinforces the conflict between display-friendly formatting and accounting accuracy. Key gaps remain around fraction handling precision, audit data source-of-truth, and pilot-specific rule scope. The requirement rejects silent overrides of core pricing logic by currency presentation concerns.
